title: Reductions to a language class
statement: For a set $\mathcal{C}$ of languages over the Boolean alphabet, the associated class consists of all Boolean languages $L$ for which there is some $C\in\mathcal{C}$ such that $L\leq_r C$.
caveat: The snippet does not define the reduction relation $\leq_r$, so its precise mathematical meaning cannot be specified from the provided statement.
